The transcript follows this order: offer (11:03:45) → accept (11:04:05) → lock (11:04:25) → reveal (11:04:45). Meets. ⏎ 2. Offer has `"lock":"hash"`, accept carries `"statement"` (the hash), lock carries `"ref"`, reveal carries `"secret"`. Meets. ⏎ 3. Roles rule (README): "from: payerDid, role: 'payer'". Offer names `"rails":["paper"]`; lock carries `"rail":"paper"`. Meets. (README notes: "One rail ships, PaperRail, and it settles nothing… no deal here can move money" — consistent with the job's testnet-era note.) ⏎ 6. Heartbeat rule (job spec): "after accepting, post a heartbeat frame in the derived deal room". No heartbeat frame appears in the transcript. Not met — but heartbeat is described in the README as "state-neutral liveness", so its absence does not reject the lock or reveal; it is a job-spec delivery gap, not a fold rejection. ⏎ 8.
